bio.text: Dean Roy is a candidate for Governor of Vermont in the November 2026 general election, running under the Freedom and Unity Party, a party he created to get on the ballot.
The Associated Press reported in March 2026 that he would be the first candidate for governor under age 18 to appear on Vermont's general election ballot.
The report noted that Vermont's constitution sets no minimum age for governor and requires four years of state residency.

sources.title: 14-year-old running for governor is the first teen to get on Vermont’s general election ballot
